name: Scratches
author: E. T. Carter
description: A worn release print running through a projector over a soft out-of-focus picture in faded print colours. Hairline vertical scratches in three layers, a wandering tramline, holders and one-frame flashes, break up along their length; dust and dirt specks, a stray hair, midtone grain and lamp flicker all step at 24 frames a second while the whole gate weaves. A chemical stain creeps in from one side.

params.label: Scratches
params.effect: Density and brightness of the vertical hairline scratches; 0 leaves only the tramline.

params.label: Dust
params.effect: Amount of dust, dirt specks and stray hairs landing in the gate; 0 is a clean print.

params.label: Grain
params.effect: Film grain strength, strongest in the midtones; 0 is a smooth digital scan.

params.label: Flicker and weave
params.effect: Lamp flicker and gate weave amplitude; 0 locks the picture rock steady.

params.label: Picture drift
params.effect: How fast the soft light shapes behind the damage wander; 0 holds a still frame.
